summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing operational treasury updates rather than a special situation. The Company reported that between October 5 and October 9, 2026, it grew its SOL and SOL-equivalent holdings by 22,070 tokens, lifting the total from 2,564,212 as of October 2 to 2,586,282 as of October 9, a 1% increase. Management stated the treasury assets will be deployed through staking, validator, and onchain infrastructure. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are implicated; this is ordinary disclosure.
